title: Alpa: Automating Inter- and Intra-Operator Parallelism for Distributed Deep Learning
description: Manually choosing data / tensor / pipeline parallelism strategies is a combinatorial search problem. Alpa automates this: it performs inter-operator parallelism planning (pipeline stages) and intra-operator parallelism planning (tensor/data split within each stage) jointly using dynamic programming. Achieves near-expert parallelism configurations automatically.
authors: Zheng, Li, Zhang, Zhuang, Chen, Liang, Cai, Vyas, Cao, Wang, Luo, Shen, Goldberg, Gonzalez, Stoica, Zaharia (Berkeley / Google)
